This neuron has no clear semantic selectivity; it fires weakly on high-frequency syntactic "juncture" tokens — commas introducing a following relative/subordinate clause, the determiner "the" heading a noun phrase, sentence-final periods, and occasional verb/pronoun continuations — and is suppressed by the very same token types in other contexts, so it appears to be a low-amplitude, polysemantic syntactic-position feature rather than a content detector.
